HEIC and HEIF decoding uses libheif-js 1.23.5 (LGPL-3.0).
The bundled browser JavaScript and embedded WebAssembly are unmodified from the npm release.
Package and usage: https://www.npmjs.com/package/libheif-js/v/1.23.5
Build scripts: https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js
Underlying library and license: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
The library can be replaced in a local build by swapping dist/vendor/libheif-bundle.js.
See LICENSE-libheif.txt for license terms.
